content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices in early-to-mid forecast horizon, especially after sharp spikes.
- Overestimates in flat or declining trends, showing persistent upward bias.
- Overshoots immediately after price spikes, then gradually corrects downward — model lags in recognizing peak decay.
- Mean reversion is not captured: model holds high forecasts too long after peaks, failing to reflect natural pullback.
- Forecasts for 30-day horizon show strong bias toward lower values when recent history is volatile or downward trending.
- Model exhibits “sticky” behavior — fails to adjust quickly to sudden drops or spikes in true outcomes.
- When true prices show strong downward momentum, model continues to forecast upward, especially in first 10–15 days.
- Correction needed: reduce forecast slope after spikes; increase downward adjustment in flat or falling trends.
